note: DEMO-ONLY contracts for the Push-native agentic demo. NOT part of the protocol deployment and never referenced by anything outside demo-native/. DemoUSDC is a freely mintable test token with no owner; StakeDummy has no owner, no pause and no supply accounting and would be drained within a block on a live network. Neither may ever be deployed to mainnet. Flat name -> address map, matching donut_push_core.json.
placeholders: Both addresses ship as the zero address deliberately. AddressBook.native() enforces a never-zero rule, so an unwritten key fails with a named MissingAddress naming the script that writes it - rather than letting a script proceed against address(0) and fail minutes later with nothing on screen explaining why.
